A0123.title: A network of spatial-temporal messages
A0123.date_type: timestamp of the exact Git wording record
A0123.date_boundary: The note carries a September20,2012 creation header, but the selected words are bound here to the June2022 Git object. Earlier public availability and original alias identity are not independently certified.
A0123.authorship_boundary: Line5 says the writer retained only their own comments, originally shared under a fictional alias. This edition attributes the2022 SAN record, not an independently authenticated2012 social-media identity.
A0123.source_context: This is an exploratory biological proposal. The passage follows a conditional hypothesis about potential differences representing neuronal state/morphology. It is not an implemented standardized packet protocol or a demonstration that the proposed carrier physics is correct.

A0079.title: Each receiving array treats upstream signals as input
A0079.date_type: timestamp of the exact Git wording record
A0079.date_boundary: Exact wording is bound to the June2022 Git record. The current byte match is not an independent proof of when the repository first became public.
A0079.authorship_boundary: A first-person SAN proposal in the source repository; the eye/LED language is an analogy for neural reception and pattern processing, not evidence of miniature conscious observers.
A0079.source_context: The surrounding text describes internal arrays receiving other arrays’ signals, network-level predictive representation, and learning-related receiver selectivity. It acknowledges anatomical incompleteness. It does not specify a complete object model or a Monty-style goal-state generator in every individual unit.

rows.title: A network built from information exchange
